findings: FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_common.py:34 non-blocking: an empty `if TYPE_CHECKING: pass` block is retained only because the design symbol map names TYPE_CHECKING as a symbol owned by this module; it is dead code that a later reader will copy without knowing why it is there.

FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:9 non-blocking: the standard-library `re` module is imported through the sibling module (`from .worker_common import _re`) so the task module depends on the foundation for an import alias that carries no meaning; a local `import re as _re` keeps the module self-contained and leaves the foundation's surface smaller.

FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_common.py:36 non-blocking: `__all__` publishes imported stdlib and module objects (Any, annotations, asyncio, json, logging, random, _cache, _re, lru_cache, TYPE_CHECKING), so `from worker_common import *` leaks them into a caller's namespace; the design's symbol map lists them as owned symbols, but a symbol map is not an API surface.

FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:8720 non-blocking: no test asserts the facade invariant this change rests on — the 82 forwarders, their stripped signatures and the resolver threading were proved by scratch scripts under /tmp that the run deleted, so a later edit that drops a forwarder or calls a moved function directly is caught only where one of the 19 test-patched names happens to be exercised.
